tasks.name: roman_to_int
tasks.description: Convert a Roman numeral string (I, V, X, L, C, D, M, with subtractive forms like IV and CM) to an integer.

tasks.name: int_to_roman
tasks.description: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 to a Roman numeral string using subtractive notation (4 is IV, 900 is CM).

tasks.name: run_length_encode
tasks.description: Run-length encode a string: each run of the same character becomes the count followed by the character, e.g. 'aaabcc' -> '3a1b2c'. Empty input returns ''.

tasks.name: run_length_decode
tasks.description: Decode a run-length string where each character is preceded by its count (which may have several digits), e.g. '3a1b12c' -> 'aaab' followed by twelve 'c'.

tasks.name: balanced_brackets
tasks.description: Return True if every (, [ and { in text is closed by the matching bracket in the right order. Other characters are ignored.

tasks.name: merge_intervals
tasks.description: Given a list of [start, end] pairs, merge every overlapping or touching pair and return the merged list sorted by start. [[1,3],[2,6],[8,10]] -> [[1,6],[8,10]].

tasks.name: top_k_words
tasks.description: Return the k most frequent words in text (case-insensitive, words are runs of letters), most frequent first; ties are broken alphabetically.
tasks.reference:
import re
from collections import Counter

def top_k_words(text, k):
    counts = Counter(re.findall(r'[a-z]+', text.lower()))
    return [w for w, _ in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))[:k]]

tasks.name: levenshtein
tasks.description: Return the edit distance between strings a and b: the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions or substitutions.

tasks.name: parse_duration
tasks.description: Parse a duration like '1h30m', '45s', '2h5s' or '1h2m3s' into a total number of seconds. Units are h, m and s, each optional but in that order.

tasks.name: format_bytes
tasks.description: Format a byte count for people using 1024-based units B, KB, MB, GB, TB with one decimal place, except plain bytes which have none: 512 -> '512 B', 1536 -> '1.5 KB', 1048576 -> '1.0 MB'.

tasks.name: spiral_order
tasks.description: Return the elements of a rectangular matrix (list of rows) in clockwise spiral order starting at the top-left.
tasks.reference:
def spiral_order(matrix):
    out = []
    rows = [list(r) for r in matrix]
    while rows:
        out += rows.pop(0)
        rows = [list(r) for r in zip(*rows)][::-1]
    return out

tasks.name: group_anagrams
tasks.description: Group words that are anagrams of each other. Return a list of groups; each group keeps the words in input order, and groups are ordered by the first appearance of their first word.

tasks.name: caesar_cipher
tasks.description: Shift every letter in text by shift places in the alphabet, wrapping around and keeping case; non-letters are unchanged. Negative shifts move backwards.

tasks.name: pascal_row
tasks.description: Return row n (0-based) of Pascal's triangle as a list of integers. Row 0 is [1], row 4 is [1, 4, 6, 4, 1].

tasks.name: dedupe_keep_order
tasks.description: Remove duplicates from a list while keeping the first occurrence of each item in its original position.

tasks.name: longest_common_prefix
tasks.description: Return the longest string that every word in the list starts with. Return '' for an empty list or when there is no common prefix.

tasks.name: binary_search
tasks.description: Return the index of target in the sorted list values using binary search, or -1 if it is not present.

tasks.name: deep_flatten
tasks.description: Flatten arbitrarily nested lists into a single flat list, keeping the order of the non-list items.

tasks.name: is_valid_ipv4
tasks.description: Return True if address is a dotted IPv4 address: exactly four decimal parts from 0 to 255, no leading zeros (except a single 0), digits only.

tasks.name: matrix_multiply
tasks.description: Multiply two matrices given as lists of rows and return the product as a list of rows. Raise ValueError if the inner dimensions don't match.

tasks.name: word_wrap
tasks.description: Wrap text into lines of at most width characters, breaking only at spaces and never splitting words (a word longer than width gets its own line). Return the list of lines.

tasks.name: count_islands
tasks.description: Count groups of horizontally or vertically connected '1' cells in a grid given as a list of strings of '0' and '1'.

tasks.name: next_greater
tasks.description: For each number, return the next number to its right that is strictly larger, or -1 if there is none. [2, 1, 3] -> [3, 3, -1].

tasks.name: slugify
tasks.description: Turn a title into a URL slug: lowercase, keep only a-z and 0-9, join the words with single hyphens, no hyphen at either end. 'Hello, World! 2024' -> 'hello-world-2024'.
